title: Deus Ex
notes: Deus Ex writes a log (System\DeusEx.log) that records every map it loads. Vault reads it, so nothing touches the game.
Each map unlocks when it loads, including from a saved game. Your last session counts even if Vault was closed.

testGuide.title: Start Deus Ex
testGuide.detail: Play from your Library and start a new game or load a save.

testGuide.title: Watch "Current map"
testGuide.detail: It should show a name like 01_NYC_UNATCOIsland. If it stays empty, copy the test report and send it to Claude.
